MR.name: Impôt sur le revenu des capitaux mobiliers, dividends (10 %)
MR.statute: CGI 2023 (French edition) art. 119-120, 126 (LFI 2024/2025 held in Arabic only, not read)
MR.doc: art. 126: 20 % on gains on securities where the seller is in a privileged-tax State, 10 % in all other cases.

MR.name: Impôt sur le revenu des capitaux mobiliers, interest on claims and deposits (10 %)
MR.doc: art. 119: IRCM on income from claims, deposits and guarantees; art. 126: 10 %; art. 122: savings-bank passbook interest and interest on bank accounts of households up to 100 000 MRU a year are exempt.
unsupported: exemption of savings-bank interest and of household bank-account interest up to 100 000 MRU a year (art. 122 1°-2°): the household's interest is taken to be taxable

MR.name: Impôt sur les revenus fonciers (10 % of rents due)
MR.doc: art. 102: taxable income = total rents due in the previous year, rounded down to 10 MRU; landlords whose only income is rent of at most 6 000 MRU a year are exempt; art. 105: rate 10 %.
unsupported: exemption of rent-only landlords up to 6 000 MRU (art. 102 4)
real-estate gains taxed under the IRF with a 5 %-a-year abatement after two years (art. 103, 107)

MR.name: Taxe d'apprentissage (0,60 % of wages)
MR.doc: art. 152: base = all salaries, wages, allowances and remuneration paid; art. 153: rate 0,60 %.
unsupported: reduction of 40 MRU per apprentice, at most 50 % (art. 151)
rounding of the base to 10 MRU

MR.name: Contribution foncière sur les propriétés bâties
MR.why: rate voted by each municipal council between 3 % and 10 % of the rental value less 20 % (art. 162, 165): no default rate in the code

MR.name: Droit d'enregistrement, mutations d'immeubles à titre onéreux (2 %)
MR.doc: art. 312: base = price plus charges and indemnities, or market value if higher; art. 313 1): transfers of immovables or real rights for consideration 2 % (1 % abroad).

MR.name: Droits d'enregistrement sur les donations entre vifs (2 % as for sales of immovables; free in the direct line and between spouses)
MR.doc: art. 325: gifts of immovables, businesses, leases or shares bear the proportional duties of the corresponding sale (immovables 2 %, art. 313) on the declared value without deduction of charges; gifts to the spouse, ascendants or descendants are registered free. No duty on successions: the code has no tariff for transfers on death.
unsupported: the gift is taken to be immovable property; gifts of a business, lease or shares bear their own sale rates
inheritances: no duty in the code (rate 0)
